q: Pesin's Lyapunov stable manifold theorem extends stable manifold theory to non-uniformly hyperbolic systems. For a.e. x w.r.t. an ergodic measure with negative Lyapunov exponent λ_s < 0 < λ_u, the stable manifold W^s(x) satisfies:
opts: W^s(x) is a C¹ submanifold tangent to the Oseledets stable space at x, with exponential contraction rate approaching λ_s
exp: Pesin's theorem: for a.e. x (w.r.t. ergodic measure with nonzero Lyapunov exponents), W^s(x) is a C¹⁺ᵅ injectively immersed submanifold tangent to the Oseledets stable space E^s(x) and satisfying d(T^nx, T^ny) ≤ C(x) e^{n(λ_s+ε)} d(x,y) for y ∈ W^s(x).
